_what: PACK DATA — WHERE A LESSON IS FILED IN THE BRAIN. Jordan, 2026-10-18: 'we should have like a GenTech EDU folder for this department… within that, there should be a folder for Jordan and then a folder for Josephine, whoever the collaborators are. Because inside of our folders, you'll have topics based on what we want to learn.' So the brain is LEARNER-first, TOPIC second.
_why_a_file_and_not_code: The engine used to hardcode EDU/lessons/<learner>/. Changing how humans file lessons would then have meant editing the engine — which is the boundary rule backwards. A filing convention is PACK data. This file is the convention.
_topic_default_rule: A dialect with no topic mapping files under `_unsorted` rather than being dropped or guessed into the wrong subject — an unsorted lesson is findable; a misfiled one is not.
_fallback: If this file is ABSENT the engine writes the LEGACY path (EDU/lessons/<learner>/) and ANNOUNCES it. A layout change must never silently file a lesson where nobody looks.
_verified: 2026-10-18 — selftest 17 proves both directions: with this file the path is learner-first, without it the engine falls back to legacy AND says so.
